summary: Phoenix New Media Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing changes to its Board of Directors and Chief Executive Officer. The Board appointed Mr. Wei Xu as a director and Chairman, and Mr. Qi Li as CEO, effective immediately. Former Chairman and CEO Mr. Yusheng Sun resigned due to personal reasons but remains a director; Mr. Ka Keung Yeung also resigned as a director. No financial terms, consideration, or premium were disclosed as this is purely a management transition. The changes are effective immediately with no shareholder vote or regulatory clock indicated. Watch for any future strategic shifts under new leadership.
